promptSet.title: Anti-Slop Modern Landing Page Prompt
promptSet.prompt: Design a high-craft landing page for a developer tool. Follow strict anti-slop rules: warm neutral off-white canvas, near-black charcoal type, zero saturated primary buttons, mono typography for technical labels, and zero generic 3-column feature cards.
instructions: Install the taste skill via npx skills add https://github.com/Leonxlnx/taste-skill --skill "design-taste-frontend".
Invoke the skill before generating any React or Tailwind components.
Run npm run lint:taste to guarantee 0 FAIL and 0 WARN compliance.
promptSet.exampleOutput: A gorgeous, bespoke editorial webpage with 75:1 contrast ratio and custom typography.
